title: GlusterFS: fix FALLOCATE/DISCARD/ZEROFILL/FXATTROP request field decoding
description:
Closes #21365

## Problem

Four GlusterFS 4.0 (`glusterfs4_0_fop`) call decoders read the wrong bytes:

| FOP | bug |
|-----|-----|
| FALLOCATE | `size` read as uint32; `gfx_fallocate_req.size` is `u_quad_t` |
| DISCARD | dispatched to the READDIRP decoder (uint32 size); `gfx_discard_req.size` is `u_quad_t` |
| ZEROFILL | trailing `xdata` dict not read |
| FXATTROP | reads `flags` before `fd`; the wire order is `fd` then `flags` |

FALLOCATE/DISCARD report `Size: 0` and a malformed packet; FXATTROP shows a real fd `N`
as `N << 32`.

## Fix

- FALLOCATE: read `size` as 64-bit (`hf_glusterfs_size64`).
- DISCARD: dispatch to the ZEROFILL decoder -- `gfx_discard_req` is byte-identical to
  `gfx_zerofill_req`.
- ZEROFILL: read the trailing `xdata`.
- FXATTROP: read `fd` before `flags`.

## Verification

On GlusterFS 11.2 captures (FALLOCATE/DISCARD/ZEROFILL via a gfapi caller, FXATTROP on a
replica-3 volume), and confirmed on a live appliance testbed: FALLOCATE `Size 3145728`,
DISCARD `1048576`, ZEROFILL `2097152` + xdata, FXATTROP fd `1`.

Bug introduced in 61aaeef2b0e (the original 4.0 dissector).

AI-assisted; all changes verified against the wire format and on a live testbed.

GlusterFS: fix FALLOCATE/DISCARD/ZEROFILL/FXATTROP request field decoding

Four GlusterFS 4.0 (glusterfs4_0_fop) call decoders read the wrong bytes:

- FALLOCATE: gfx_fallocate_req.size is u_quad_t but was read as uint32,
  so size showed 0 and the trailing dict misaligned (Malformed Packet).
- DISCARD: was dispatched to the READDIRP decoder, whose size is uint32;
  gfx_discard_req.size is u_quad_t. gfx_discard_req is byte-identical to
  gfx_zerofill_req, so reuse the (now complete) ZEROFILL decoder.
- ZEROFILL: did not read the trailing xdata dict (gfx_zerofill_req).
- FXATTROP: read flags before fd; gfx_fxattrop_req is fd then flags, so
  both scalars decoded as garbage (a real fd N showed as N<<32).

Verified against GlusterFS 11.2 captures (FALLOCATE/DISCARD/ZEROFILL via
gfapi, FXATTROP on a replica-3 volume).

Introduced in 61aaeef2b0e ("dissector/gluster: Add dissector for Gluster
4.0 protocol").

Closes #21365
